mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.2% (as of t-1mo) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%, or the signal fails to outperform the market by at least 1.5% in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.5% (as of t-1mo) indicates severe labor market weakness, triggering risk-off sentiment that depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5, or the signal fails to outperform the market by at least 1.5% in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 0.5% in the prior month signals deteriorating consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 0.5% and RSAFS declines > 0.5% in prior month
failure_condition: The joint decline condition occurs but S&P 500 returns are positive in > 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 220) combined with an upward trend in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.1% in prior month) signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 220 AND FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% in prior month
failure_condition: The joint condition (CPIAUCSL > 220 and FEDFUNDS rise > 0.1%) occurs but S&P 500 returns are positive in > 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above 95 (index 2017=100) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 95, or the signal fails to outperform the market by at least 0.5% in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment level above 130,000 (thousands of persons) indicates strong job growth, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings to drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000, or the signal fails to outperform the market by at least 2.0% in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 0.5% in the prior month signals an impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 0.5% and RSAFS declines > 0.5% in prior month
failure_condition: The joint decline condition occurs in late-cycle expansions but S&P 500 returns are positive in > 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%) combined with a low inflation index (CPIAUCSL <= 220) indicates a stable monetary environment that encourages risk-taking, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS <= 0.2% and CPIAUCSL <= 220) occurs but S&P 500 returns are negative in > 50% of such instances.
